newsitem.title: UK: Fleet Support gets UK Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: Fleet Support gets UK Navy contract.

text.p: A joint venture between Vosper Thornycroft Holdings Plc and VSEL Plc will shortly receive a five-year contract to run the UK Royal Navy's Fleet Maintenance and Repair Organisation (FMRO), Armed Forces Minister John Reid said on Tuesday.

He said in a parliamentary written answer that the companies' joint venture Fleet Support Ltd had been selected as preferred bidder for the Portsmouth-based contract, for which he gave no price details..

"Although there will initially be some redundancies, FSL's bid provides the most promising set of arrangements for the future of the FMRO and its workforce, and for the people of Plymouth," Reid said.
"It offers excellent value for money, with savings of over 30 pct." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7767
